hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv Managed_Inputs.csv unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-0c2e7d88-731d-4e37-9af3-435c54e71610' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $conn_pass ]] then echo "Secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi database_psql_host_address='harmonizeddb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB="dccharmonized"
echo "testing connection to db" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="$DB" \ -c "\q" # This command tests the connection and exits
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 255 else echo "Connection test succeeded - conn_user=$conn_user database_psql_host_address=$database_psql_host_address DB=$DB" fi
echo "Establishing necessary schemas" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "ALTER DATABASE $DB set client_min_messages=warning" \ -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_reports" \ -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS tablefunc"
echo "fetching applicable study/version list for dcc" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\COPY (SELECT * from util.study_versions) to study_versions.csv WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)"
IFS=',' while read phs version; do echo "$phs.$version" if [[ $phs == 'phs000289' ]] || [[ $phs == 'phs001402' ]]; then echo "$phs belongs to mayovte, which has a non-compatible consent issue. skipping"
elif [[ ! -z `grep $phs Managed_Inputs.csv` ]]; then echo "$phs present in managed_inputs, fetching patient mapping" export query="select \"Study Abbreviated Name\" from Managed_Inputs where \"Study Identifier\" = '$phs'" echo $query abv=`csvsql --query $query Managed_Inputs.csv | csvformat -E` echo "abv is $abv" mkdir $abv aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv,,}/data/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv $abv sed -i "s/${abv^^}/${phs}/g" $abv/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\COPY hpds_mappings.merged_mappings from '$abv/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv' WITH (FORMAT CSV)" curl --retry 5 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 5 --show-error --silent 'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gap/sstr/report/study/'${phs}'.'${version}'/subjects/download?study_accession_version='${phs}'.'${version}'&order_col=0&order_dir=asc&filter_text=&data_format=row&columns=SUBJECT_ID%20%2C%20dbgap_subject_id' \ -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' -H 'Connection: keep-alive' > ${phs}_${version}_telemetry_report.tsv if [[ ! -z `grep "<!DOCTYPE html>" ${phs}_${version}_telemetry_report.tsv` ]]; then echo "${phs}.${version}" >> studies_needing_manual_pulls.txt else csvformat -t ${phs}_${version}_telemetry_report.tsv > ${phs}_${version}_telemetry_report.csv PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "drop table if exists telemetry_reports.${phs}_${version}" \ -c "create table telemetry_reports.${phs}_${version} (subject_id text, dbgap_subject_id integer)" \ -c "\COPY telemetry_reports.${phs}_${version} from ${phs}_${version}_telemetry_report.csv CSV HEADER" fi else echo "$phs not ingested by picsure. skipping" fi
done < study_versions.csv
if [[ ! -z studies_needing_manual_pulls.txt ]]; then echo "Studies too big to automate telemetry pull from dbgap: " cat studies_needing_manual_pulls.txt; exit 255; fi
